description: PHYSICALITY - THE 'GOT THE BALL' EXCUSE GETS SHORTER. WHAT CHANGES: one number, and it does not touch the contact score at all. When the referee's contact loop (match::ai::Judge) decides whether a collision was a foul, it lets a challenge off if the tackler's own kick event happened within a short window of the contact frame. That window is 0.06 s; this pack makes it 0.05 s. A tackle that got a toe on the ball a frame late stops being excused. WHY THIS IS THE SAFE HALF OF THE OLD PACK: the earlier version of phys-late-challenge also raised two SCORE terms. That was wrong to ship as written, because the contact score is a single byte (0x143d891cd 'add bl,al'; 0x143d891d9 'add al,bl'; 0x143d891e0 'movzx eax,al') and that same byte is what the level function tests against 80 (yellow) and 110 (red). Raising any score term therefore raises CARD counts, not just free kicks. Those two edits now live in phys-reckless-contact.json with the consequence spelled out. This pack changes no score, so it cannot move any card line: it only removes escapes, i.e. it lets some currently-ignored contacts be scored at all. WHO IT AFFECTS: everyone. The Judge is handed two player slots and never asks which side is human, so your own defenders lose the excuse too. EVIDENCE: READ FROM UNAMBIGUOUS DISASSEMBLY (level b), re-read this pass. 0x143d88658 loads the constant into xmm9; at 0x143d8879b-0x143d887a5 it becomes N = trunc(fps*K + 0.5) frames, and 0x143d887b4 'comiss N, gap / jb' compares it against |contact frame - kick frame|. Smaller N is strictly fewer escapes. Nothing here is emulated and nothing needs to be - it is one comparison. FRAME-RATE TABLE, because this is a rounded frame count and the old spec omitted the rate most PC players actually run. N = trunc(fps*K+0.5) in float32: at 27 fps 2 -> 1; at 30 fps 2 -> 2 (no change); at 54 fps 3 -> 3 (no change); at 60 fps 4 -> 3; at 120 fps 7 -> 6. So at 60 fps this is a one-frame, 25% cut. At 27 fps it is a 50% cut - if you play capped that low, skip this pack. WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN A MATCH: a lunge that arrives a frame after the ball has gone now gets whistled instead of waved on. Everything else should feel identical - nothing is scored any harder. STRONGER VERSION: 0.04 s (re-aim to cell 0x1463336c8, patch bytes F3440F100D67B05A02). That is 4 -> 2 frames at 60 fps, a 50% cut - noticeably more aggressive, which is why it is not the default. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/phys-late-challenge.json

patches.name: 'played the ball' amnesty window 0.06 s -> 0.05 s
patches.note: movss xmm9, [0x1466af9f0 = 0.06] re-aimed to [0x145b5588c = 0.05]. Converted to N = trunc(fps*K+0.5) frames at 0x143d8879b and compared against the |contact - kick| frame gap at 0x143d887b4. Target cell is .tls$, writers=0, ptr_refs=0 - the cell is never written.
